rows.grounds: fused compound naming the self presided over by the power of action
accusative object of the implied predication

items.question: Which reality is named the twenty-fifth puruṣa whose self is presided over by the power of action?
premises: Its self is presided over by action power.
items.inference: The twenty-fifth tattva is puruṣa, whose self is presided over by kriyāśakti.
uncertainties: The exact relation to the preceding lotus and guṇa triad is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: The twenty-fifth tattva is puruṣa, the person whose self is presided over by the power of action.
